name: clean-decision

items.title: Onboarding launch scope
items.summary: Decide whether the onboarding experiment should launch to all new teams or stay in beta.
items.why: The team explicitly frames the decision question.

items.title: Enterprise SSO setup risk
items.summary: Enterprise teams may get stuck if onboarding launches before SSO setup is automated.
items.option_value: Exclude enterprise teams to preserve launch flexibility while SSO setup remains manual.
items.why: The transcript names a concrete downside and affected segment.

items.title: Launch onboarding to non-enterprise teams
items.summary: Launch onboarding to non-enterprise teams next Monday while keeping enterprise teams in beta.
items.tradeoff: Launch to non-enterprise teams even over one broad launch.
items.why: The transcript uses explicit decision and agreement language.

items.title: Update launch config and support note
items.summary: Luis will update the launch config and Maya will write the support note by Friday.
items.human_judgment_role: Confirms owners and timing rather than inferring them.
items.why: The cue is explicitly labeled Action and names owners plus timing.

should_not_emit: Do not create a separate accepted decision for the mitigation at 00:29; it is part of the launch-scope decision.
Do not create an agent issue unless it adds a host-usable intervention beyond the explicit risk and mitigation.
